description: Variation of Conditions 2 (Approved Plans) and 13 (Quantum of Development) of planning permission 20/04194/EIAFUL (as amended by non-material amendment 26/01297/NMC dated 29.05.2026) for the:"Demolition of all existing buildings and comprehensive redevelopment of the site to erect buildings ranging up to 18 storeys to create residential units (Use Class C3), alongside flexible community and commercial uses on the Landor Road frontage (Use Classes E and F2), open space, garden areas, children's play areas, disabled parking, cycle parking and supporting infrastructure, together with amended vehicular and pedestrian access from Landor Road." Granted 11.09.2023.Variation sought: Amendments to the approved development comprising an increase from 551 to 722 residential units; revised building layouts and internal arrangements, including changes arising from current fire safety and Building Regulations requirements; provision of 276.12 sqm of flexible Class E/F2 floorspace fronting Landor Road; realignment of the central boulevard and associated public realm; relocation and reinstatement of the two locally listed gate piers at the Landor Road entrance; and associated amendments to the landscaping and energy strategy.The proposed development does not accord with the provisions of the development plan in force in the area in which the application site is situated.This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement (ES) Addendum and Non-Technical Summary (NTS), which can be viewed on Lambeth's online planning register at https://planning.lambeth.gov.uk/online-applications/ using the application reference 26/02069/VOC. Electronic or printed copies can be requested from mail@iceniprojects.com quoting "Environmental Statement Request - Lambeth Hospital" in the email subject line or telephone +44 (0)20 3640 8508; printed copies may be subject to a reasonable charge.
